visible_evidence: Water being poured into a measuring cup
Measuring cup filled with water to the 12 oz mark

steps.text: Place-Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
visible_evidence: Hand placing a coffee dripper onto the rim of a mug
Dripper resting stably on top of the coffee mug

checks.text: The dripper rests directly on top of the coffee mug

visible_evidence: Coffee beans placed on a kitchen scale
Scale display showing the weight of the coffee beans

checks.text: The coffee beans are placed on a scale

steps.text: Grind-Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
visible_evidence: Coffee beans added to a grinder and grinder operating
Ground coffee with a coarse sand-like texture

checks.text: The coffee grounds have a coarse sand-like texture
The grinder runs for approximately 20 seconds

steps.text: Prepare-Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
visible_evidence: Hands folding a round paper filter in half
Paper filter folded twice into a quarter-circle shape

checks.text: The paper filter is folded in half to form a semi-circle
The paper filter is folded in half a second time to form a quarter-circle

visible_evidence: Water being poured from a measuring cup into a kettle
Kettle containing water

checks.text: The measured water is poured into the kettle

steps.text: Place-Place the paper filter in the dripper
visible_evidence: Hand inserting the folded paper filter into the dripper
Paper filter seated inside the dripper

checks.text: The folded paper filter is seated inside the dripper

steps.text: Boil-Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
visible_evidence: Kettle turned on or placed on a heat source
Steam rising or bubbles forming in the kettle

checks.text: The water in the kettle reaches a boil with visible steam or bubbling

steps.text: spread-spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
visible_evidence: Fingers opening the layers of the folded paper filter inside the dripper
Paper filter forming an open cone lining the dripper

checks.text: The paper filter is opened into a cone shape lining the inside of the dripper

steps.text: check-Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
visible_evidence: Thermometer probe inserted into the hot water in the kettle
Thermometer display showing the water temperature

checks.text: A thermometer is used to measure the temperature of the boiled water
The thermometer reads between 195 and 205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91 and 96 degrees Celsius

steps.text: Transfer-Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
visible_evidence: Coffee grounds being poured or spooned into the paper filter cone
Coffee grounds sitting inside the open filter cone

checks.text: The coffee grounds are placed inside the opened paper filter cone

steps.text: Pour-Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
visible_evidence: Kettle pouring a small stream of hot water onto the coffee grounds
Coffee grounds visibly darkened and saturated with water

checks.text: A small amount of water is poured over the grounds so they are evenly wetted

steps.text: Wait-Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
visible_evidence: Pouring paused while wet grounds sit in the dripper
Small bubbles and foam rising on the surface of the wet coffee grounds

checks.text: Pouring is paused for approximately 30 seconds
Small bubbles or foam appear on the surface of the wet coffee grounds

steps.text: pour-Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
visible_evidence: Kettle moving in a circular motion while pouring a steady stream of water
Water level remaining below the top edge of the paper filter

checks.text: The water is poured slowly in a circular motion over the coffee grounds
The water level stays below the top edge of the paper filter

steps.text: drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
visible_evidence: Liquid level dropping in the dripper until only wet grounds remain
Dripper lifted off the mug after dripping stops

checks.text: All liquid drains out of the dripper into the mug before the dripper is lifted

steps.text: Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
visible_evidence: Hand lifting the used paper filter containing wet grounds out of the dripper
Used filter and grounds placed into a trash bin or compost container

checks.text: The used paper filter and coffee grounds are removed from the dripper and disposed of
